system.description:
EYE OF THE GODS: Gods reward devoted followers. Advance the token on the Eye of the Gods!

The Chaotic Fury token moves one space each time a PC rolls one or more {Dm} on a check against a Chaos target. Once the token reaches space 3, all Chaos units increase their by +1. If it reaches all 3 spaces, Chaos units gain the Invigorated and Inspired conditions. These conditions remain in effect until the end of the encounter.
CHAOTIC FURY: The token moves one space each time a Chaos adversary inflicts a critical wound or generates a {Dm} on an attack. When the token reaches space 4, one Chaos character gains a mutation. When it reaches space 8, one Chaos adversary gains two mutations. Then, reset the tracking mechanism to 0. Fury The Ruinous Powers channel their fury into their battle-thirsty followers. Advance
